major_concerns: Emulator/device-model fidelity may bias measured failure reductions vs. production devices.
Operational definition of “unsafe” is underspecified and may vary by vendor/context.
Formal verifier coverage for vendor CLI idiosyncrasies is likely incomplete; false negatives/positives risk confounding results.
Engineering/integration bugs (toolchain) could masquerade as scientific effects if not isolated.
Single‑model evaluation risks overclaiming generality across LLMs.
required_design_repairs: Specify precise, machine‑checkable unsafe predicates and how they map to verifier semantics and sandbox observables.
Document verifier formalism (Batfish/NetKAT rules) and per‑vendor modeling gaps; include negative/coverage tests for verifier correctness.
Define dataset provenance/licensing and show representative intent distribution per vendor; preregister inclusion/exclusion rules.
Add robustness checks: ablation (no‑repair), varying retrieval quality, and at least one sensitivity run on a second LLM or model checkpoint to bound model‑specific effects.
Predefine retry/engineering‑failure policies and include toolchain unit tests and independent hashable artifact snapshots for each pipeline component.

major_concerns: External validity: simulated topologies and operator heuristics may not reflect production failure rates.
Invariant specification (what constitutes a failure) needs formalization to avoid ambiguous labels.
Potential imbalance in intent→vendor mapping could bias randomized comparisons if not stratified.
Risk of overstating real‑world applicability given sandboxed emulation.
Operator‑simulated interventions are design choices that can dominate outage duration estimates.
required_design_repairs: Formally enumerate invariants with precise test procedures (reachability checks, ACL semantics) and map to observable sandbox metrics.
Preregister stratification scheme ensuring vendor and change‑type balance across conditions; include power/sample‑size justification.
Define and justify simulator operator heuristics; preregister sensitivity analyses and ranges for heuristics.
Log full raw telemetry and provide deterministic replay scripts; include mitigation-detection latency measurement methodology.
Constrain claims in manuscript to simulated/near‑production evidence and explicitly report limitations on production extrapolation.

major_concerns: Licensing and provenance of vendor examples could prevent public release of the dataset.
Fine‑tuning resource requirements conflict with available local GPU (none); plan depends on hosted fine‑tuning capabilities.
Synthetic paraphrase generation risks introducing artifacts that overestimate model gains.
Dataset curation bias (vendor/command overrepresentation) may limit generality.
Tokenization and model‑specific training details must be exact to permit reproducibility.
required_design_repairs: Provide a concrete licensing/provenance plan and remove any non‑redistributable content; document provenance for every sample.
If local fine‑tuning is infeasible, specify exact hosted‑API fine‑tuning procedure or restrict experiments to RAG/adapter methods that fit capability constraints.
Describe paraphrase generation controls (semantic preservation checks) and include a human validation subset or verifier pass to limit artifact leakage.
Define train/val/test splits with held‑out vendors and report tokenization/encoder settings and all hyperparameters; include scripts to reproduce dataset preprocessing.
Temporally scope claims about dataset impact; include scaling controls and explicit caveats about synthetic vs. human‑authored intents.

major_concerns: Simulated operator agents may not capture real human judgement, limiting external validity of gate rankings.
Choice of calibration priors could meaningfully change results; risk of presenting simulation as substitute for human studies.
UI and human‑factors aspects are approximated; workload proxies (decision time) may be weak surrogates.
Potential deterministic interactions between gate heuristics and simulated agents could produce optimistic results.
Risk of overclaiming about practical deployment without human validation.
required_design_repairs: Preregister calibration priors and source literature for simulated operator parameters; include wide sensitivity sweeps and report robustness of gate ordering.
Validate simulated operator behavior against any available small human study or published human decision data; if unavailable, clearly qualify claims as simulation‑based.
Define and justify workload proxies; where possible, triangulate decision‑time proxies with other workload indicators (e.g., number of flags consulted).
Include stochasticity in simulated agents and repeat runs with different seeds; report variance and confidence intervals of gate rankings.
Limit manuscript claims to simulated evidence and recommend follow‑up human studies; provide reproducible simulation code and parameter tables.
